title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Equipment Rate Classes and Product Availability
content:
## Equipment types and their rate class

Every Demurrage and Detention Free Time product maps equipment types to one of three rate classes in the same way:

| Equipment type | Rate class |
|---|---|
| 20DV, 40DV, 40HC, 45HC | dry |
| 20RF, 40RH | reefer |
| 20OT, 40OT, 20FR, 40FR, 20TK | special |

## Which classes a product accepts, and how it reaches a record

A product can be applied only to a container whose rate class is among the classes it accepts. The contract tier column shows the minimum service contract tier rank a booking needs for its records to open on the product; a 0 there means the product requires no contract at all.

| Product | Classes accepted | Lowest contract tier rank | How the product comes onto a record |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | dry, reefer, special | 0 | applied by default |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | dry, reefer, special | 0 | bought for a record whose free time is running |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | dry, reefer | 0 | bought for a record whose free time is running |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | dry, reefer, special | 0 | bought for a record whose free time is running |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | dry | 0 | bought for a record whose free time is running |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | dry, reefer, special | 4 | on bookings rated under an active service contract of tier rank 4 or higher |

## Points of judgement

- A 40RH unit is reefer class in the map; AHL Combined Free Time 21 does not accept that class, whereas AHL Combined Free Time 14 does.
- A 20TK unit is special class, which AHL Free Time Extension 7 and AHL Combined Free Time 21 do not accept.
- A 45HC unit is dry class and is accepted by every product in the range.
